title: RAG — Retrieval-Augmented Generation
key_concepts: The RAG pipeline: load → chunk → embed → store → retrieve → generate
Naive RAG vs advanced RAG (HyDE, re-ranking, multi-query)
Context window management and stuffing vs. map-reduce
expected_skills: Build an end-to-end RAG pipeline using LangChain + Chroma
Evaluate retrieval quality using standard metrics
Apply HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings) to improve retrieval
Handle context overflow with map-reduce summarisation
sample_questions: Walk me through the steps of a basic RAG pipeline from document ingestion to answer generation.
What is HyDE and how does it improve retrieval quality compared to naive embedding search?
How do you handle documents that exceed the LLM's context window in a RAG system?
What metrics would you use to evaluate the quality of retrieval in your RAG pipeline?
